addition.item: Changelog shown in Joomla: "Changelog" button in System > Update > Extensions and in System > Manage > Extensions

change.item: The build stops when the changelog has no entry for the version being released

addition.item: New sppb_get_site_info tool: site and administrator URLs, Joomla and SP Page Builder versions, URL settings
Every page result includes its URLs (frontend, friendly menu URL, SP Page Builder editor), so the AI can open the page and check the result
Joomla update server: new versions appear in System > Update > Extensions and install with one click (SHA-256/SHA-512 verified)

change.item: Dashboard redesigned with native Joomla 6 components: toolbar actions, native tabs, status table with a dedicated Actions column, standard history table
Server instructions include the site address and ask the AI to verify changes in a browser when one is available

addition.item: Update notice when the MCP client (Claude Desktop extension or client package) is older than the version shipped by the site, both in the dashboard and in Claude
The bridge ping reports the component version and the latest client version

note.item: Claude Desktop extensions 1.2.0 do not report their version: update them once from the dashboard to receive future notices

addition.item: Claude Desktop extension (.mcpb) generated for each site: one-click install, site URL prefilled, API token stored securely by Claude Desktop
Ready-made prompts: analyze a page, create a landing page, edit a page, site health check
Server instructions that guide the AI to work safely (outline first, per-element edits, unpublished pages, confirmation before deleting)

security.item: Every change made through the MCP bridge and every rollback is written to Joomla's User Actions Log
Failed authentication attempts are logged to administrator/logs/sppb_mcp_auth.php; authentication errors are uniform and do not reveal which users exist
Write actions require POST; the API token is no longer embedded in the dashboard HTML
Explicit permission checks in the dashboard (charset conversion, rollback, client package download)
Input validation for addon names, column layouts and presets

fix.item: Saving an SP Page Builder layout on an article failed with error 500 on MySQL/MariaDB strict mode
Dates are stored in UTC as Joomla expects
Database connections with host:port, sockets, IPv6 and SSL
Not found pages return 404 instead of success

addition.item: Pages open in the SP Page Builder editor by another user are not modified (HTTP 409)
Option to limit the automatic MCP backups kept for each page

change.item: Every change runs in a database transaction with a page lock
MCP tool annotations (read-only and destructive tools); write tools hidden in read-only mode
Locked dependencies for the MCP client package

security.item: The component options (gateway, read-only mode, force HTTPS, allowed groups, snapshots) are now enforced by the bridge
Disabling the Joomla API token plugins also revokes access to the bridge
The API token is never created or re-enabled automatically: explicit Generate / Regenerate API Token action
Uninstalling the component removes the /api/sppb-mcp.php endpoint

fix.item: The installer no longer depends on the Joomla 6 backward compatibility plugin
Package archives built on Windows used backslash paths
